snippet.title: Mononoke no Kuni – A Journey to Save Your Lost Dog Companion –  Bitsummit2026 Trailer
snippet.description:
Even beyond the world, with you. Never apart. 
 
Taiki, a lonely boy, suddenly loses his only family—his beloved puppy, Musashi. Overcome with grief, he prays at a shrine, and Musashi is miraculously revived as an "Inubashira," a divine canine. However, he is bound by mysterious cursed chains. 
A shrine maiden, Kushinada, appears and tells Taiki, "If you gather the sacred relics from Mononoke No Kuni, you can save Musashi." Yet, this journey is not so simple. As they venture forth, an unexpected truth begins to unravel. 
Set in a world where myths and yokai breathe life, this action-adventure follows a boy and his faithful pup as they challenge both fate and their unbreakable bond. 
Three sacred relics, the whispers of yokai, and a hidden truth waiting to be uncovered. And in the end, the final choice. —Is the path you take to save Musashi truly the right one? 
 
Steam Coming in Autumn 2026.

Official X：@MononokeNoKuni
Steam Page：https://store.steampowered.com/app/2597610/_/?l=japanese
